options: Soap helps lift away germs and grease

questions.prompt: Where should you cross a road near school?

questions.prompt: Suggest three ways your class can stop germs from spreading.
questions.modelAnswer: Wash hands with soap before lunch and after the toilet. Cover coughs and sneezes with an elbow or tissue. Keep the classroom clean, open windows for fresh air, and stay home when sick.
